jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job ID
70924
Category
Enterprise Technology
Location
Chennai, India
Work Type
On\-site  

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Full Stack Engineer to join our engineering team. This role is critical to designing, developing, and delivering scalable, high\-quality software solutions that power our products. You will work at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution — collaborating with Product Owners, Product Managers, and Architects to translate business needs into optimal technical solutions, while championing engineering excellence, Agile best practices, and the adoption of agentic AI tools across the software development lifecycle (SDLC).


This role is ideal for an engineer who is not only technically strong in full stack and microservices development, but also curious and proactive about integrating agentic AI development practices — such as AI coding agents, autonomous/semi\-autonomous workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers — into everyday engineering work to improve speed, quality, and consistency.


* Solution Design \& Development: Work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, and Architects to design and develop optimal, scalable technical solutions that meet both business and user needs.
* Backlog \& Risk Management: Understand business priorities, user needs, and technical feasibility to help prioritize the product backlog, and proactively manage risks and dependencies across features and teams.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross\-functional teams (QA, DevOps, UX, Product) to deliver timely, high\-quality, and well\-tested code that meets defined acceptance criteria and quality standards.
* Microservices Development: Design and develop microservices architecture, building loosely coupled services that decompose larger applications into smaller, well\-defined, independently deployable components.
* API Development: Design, build, and maintain APIs that enable seamless communication and integration between individual microservices and external systems.
* Code Quality \& Automation: Enforce best practices in refactoring, continuous integration, and automation to ensure code is clean, maintainable, and scalable over time.
* Agile \& DevOps Practices: Actively participate in Daily Stand\-ups and other Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog grooming). Champion the adoption of Agile, DevOps, and software craftsmanship practices, including CI/CD, Test\-Driven Development (TDD), and Pair Programming.
* ### **Agentic AI in the Development Lifecycle**
* Integrate agentic AI tools and coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar AI agents) into day\-to\-day development workflows to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and code review.
* Design and implement agentic development workflows where AI agents autonomously or semi\-autonomously handle well\-defined engineering tasks (e.g., scaffolding services, generating unit tests, refactoring code, resolving bugs) under human oversight.
* Configure, integrate, and work with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to connect AI agents with internal tools, APIs, codebases, and data sources in a secure and governed manner.
* Evaluate and apply prompt engineering and context management best practices to maximize the effectiveness, reliability, and safety of AI\-assisted development outputs.
* Establish guardrails, validation steps, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints to ensure AI\-generated code meets quality, security, and compliance standards before merging.
* Continuously experiment with and evaluate emerging agentic AI tools, frameworks, and patterns (e.g., multi\-agent orchestration, autonomous coding agents, AI\-driven CI/CD pipelines), and share learnings and recommendations with the broader engineering team.
* Partner with architects and platform teams to define standards and best practices for responsible, secure, and scalable use of agentic AI across the SDLC.
* Technical Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and mid\-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, engineering excellence, and effective AI\-augmented development.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and industry trends — especially in agentic AI and AI\-assisted software engineering — and proactively recommend improvements to team processes, architecture, and tooling.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated full stack expertise (front\-end and back\-end).
* Strong experience designing and building microservices architectures.
* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python).
* Experience with front\-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular) and back\-end frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, Node.js).
* Solid understanding of RESTful API design and development; experience with API gateways and service\-to\-service communication.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling
* Practical, hands\-on experience using agentic AI coding tools and assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) as part of the daily development workflow.
* Working knowledge of agentic development processes — understanding how AI agents plan, reason, and execute multi\-step engineering tasks with appropriate human oversight.
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and how they are used to connect AI agents/LLMs with internal tools, data sources, and codebases.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience actively participating in Agile ceremonies.
* Practical experience with Test\-Driven Development (TDD), unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience working with GCP cloud platforms
* Excellent problem\-solving ski

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable AI/ML solutions, leveraging Python, SQL, pandas, numpy, and modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit‑Learn)
* Oversee end‑to‑end ML workflows\-from data preparation, feature engineering, EDA, and model development to evaluation, deployment, and continuous monitoring
* Guide model selection, optimization, and tuning, ensuring solutions balance performance, explainability, cost, and Responsible AI principles
* Build and maintain production‑grade ML pipelines with orchestration and experiment‑tracking tools such as MLflow, Feature Stores, ONNX, and vector databases
* Lead drift analysis, observability, and model health monitoring to ensure ongoing accuracy, reliability, and robustness in production environments
* Design and support scalable, multi‑cloud ML infrastructure (Azure/GCP primary, AWS optional), incorporating best practices for compute, storage, networking, and distributed data processing
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to integrate real‑time and batch pipelines built on Synapse/BigQuery, Dataflow/Databricks, and Kafka/EventHub/PubSub
* Work closely with engineering, product, data science, and UX to translate business requirements into actionable technical solutions and architecture patterns
* Review and guide the creation of architecture diagrams, C4 models, ADRs, and technical specifications as part of engineering governance
* Mentor and coach data scientists and ML engineers on best practices in model development, experimentation, coding standards, optimization, and cloud‑native ML deployment
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field
* 12\+ years of experience in Data Science, AI/ML, or a similar role, with 2\+ years in leadership roles
* Experience with the full life cycle of AI/ML projects, including EDA, model development, tuning, and drift analysis
* Hands\-on experience in delivering production\-grade AI/ML projects
* Solid programming skills in Python, with experience in pandas, numpy, and SQL
* Proficiency in frameworks such as Scikit Learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch
* Solid understanding of mathematical and statistical concepts
* Proven excellent problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills
* Solid communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in a team environment

 **Preferred Qualification:**

* Knowledge of Big Data technologies (PySpark, Hadoop) and data streaming tools (Kafka, etc.)

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone \- of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income \- deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

AI Engineer – GenAI / AI Applications

**Company:** Imagine Technologies  
**Location:** Hyderabad / Remote  
**Experience:** 1\+ years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

About the Role

We are looking for an **AI Engineer** with hands\-on experience building real\-world applications using modern AI development tools and LLM technologies.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable using tools such as **Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other AI\-assisted development platforms**, and should understand how to integrate LLMs into production applications.

You will work on AI\-powered products, automation, chatbots, agents, and intelligent business applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop AI\-powered applications using LLMs.
* Build applications using **Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or similar LLM platforms**.
* Use **Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding tools** effectively for application development.
* Design and implement **AI agents, tool calling and function calling** workflows.
* Work with **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** and build or integrate MCP servers/tools where appropriate.
* Integrate AI models with databases, APIs, SaaS platforms and enterprise systems.
* Develop **RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation)** applications using vector databases and embeddings.
* Work with prompt engineering, structured outputs and context management.
* Develop AI chatbots, copilots, automation workflows and intelligent assistants.
* Build integrations with REST APIs and third\-party services.
* Write clean, maintainable and production\-ready code.
* Debug, test and optimize AI applications for reliability, performance and cost.
* Work closely with senior engineers/product teams to convert business requirements into AI solutions.

Required Skills

* **1\+ years of software development / AI application development experience.**
* Hands\-on experience building applications using **Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or other LLMs**.
* Practical experience with **Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding assistants**.
* Strong programming skills in at least one of:
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* Python
* Node.js
* Understanding of **LLM APIs, prompt engineering and function/tool calling**.
* Understanding of **RAG, embeddings and vector databases**.
* Experience working with REST APIs and databases.
* Good understanding of Git and modern software development practices.
* Ability to independently research, experiment and solve problems using AI tools.

Good to Have

* Experience with **MCP (Model Context Protocol)**.
* Experience building or integrating **MCP servers and MCP tools**.
* Experience with AI agents / agentic workflows.
* Experience with **LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks**.
* Experience with Supabase, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or other modern databases.
* Experience with vector databases such as **pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate or Qdrant**.
* Experience with Next.js / React / Node.js.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
* Experience with Docker and serverless architectures.
* Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, security and production deployment.

We are particularly interested in candidates who **build things with AI rather than only study AI**.

You should be comfortable taking a requirement such as:

"Build an AI assistant that can understand a user's request, retrieve information from multiple sources, call external APIs, and perform an action."

…and independently figure out the architecture, tools, prompts, integrations and implementation.

Experience with **Claude \+ Cursor/Claude Code \+ MCP \+ LLM APIs \+ RAG/Agents** will be highly valuable.

Interview Process

Candidates may be asked to demonstrate a previous AI project or complete a practical technical exercise involving:

* LLM integration
* AI\-assisted development

jobs.title: AI Engineer II
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**


The AI Engineer will help manage the organization's AI technology estate end\-to\-end — from platform administration and licensing through to usage monitoring, cost control, and governance. This is a highly technical, operationally\-focused role suited to someone who enjoys managing infrastructure and data\-driven reporting, ensuring the business gets maximum value and control from its AI tools while keeping usage secure, compliant, and cost\-effective.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer the organization's AI platforms and tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent), including user provisioning, seat/license management, and access controls.
* Manage the full lifecycle of AI licensing: seat allocation across teams, and right\-sizing licenses (e.g., Standard vs. Premium seats) based on actual usage patterns.
* Monitor and report on AI usage and spend across the organization, building dashboards and regular reports for leadership on adoption, cost, ROI, and utilization trends.
* Set and manage spend limits, usage policies, and cost controls at the organizational and user level to prevent budget overruns.
* Configure and maintain integrations, connectors, and admin settings (SSO, SCIM, audit logs, data retention policies) across AI platforms.
* Act as the internal point of contact for AI platform troubleshooting, access issues, and vendor support escalations.
* Maintain an accurate inventory (the "AI estate") of all AI tools, licenses, connectors, and integrations in use across the business, including shadow IT discovery where relevant.
* Evaluate new AI tools, features, and licensing models as they become available, and make recommendations on adoption or consolidation.
* Ensure AI tool usage aligns with the organization's security, data governance, and compliance requirements.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 3\+ years of experience in IT administration, systems/platform management, or a similar technical operations role.
* Hands\-on experience managing SaaS platform administration (user provisioning, licensing, SSO/SCIM configuration) — experience with AI platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI/ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, etc.) strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience building usage/cost reports and dashboards (Excel, Power BI, or similar).
* Familiarity with API\-based usage billing models and cost management practices.

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical usage data into business\-relevant insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with vendor account management/support teams for renewals, escalations, and contract queries.
* A proactive, detail\-oriented approach to license optimization and cost control.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* Prior experience specifically administering an enterprise AI platform (e.g., Claude for Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI Enterprise).

* Exposure to IT asset management (ITAM) or software asset management (SAM) practices.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**AI Engineer, Agentic Systems, Lawyered**

**Location:** Gurgaon (Hybrid) \| **Experience:** 3–6 years \| **Type:** Full\-time

**Company:** Lawyered, part of the India Accelerator ecosystem

**About Lawyered**


Lawyered is building AI\-native legal help for India. We're moving beyond chatbots that answer questions to **AI agents that act**: they take a user's legal problem from intake to resolution by researching the law, drafting documents, filing on government portals, tracking cases, and escalating to human lawyers when judgment is needed.

**The Role**


You'll architect and ship autonomous and semi\-autonomous agents that do real legal work end\-to\-end. That means designing how agents plan, use tools, remember context, recover from failure, and know when to hand off to a human. In a regulated domain, reliability, auditability, and safety are core to the job, not afterthoughts.

**What You'll Build**

* **Multi\-agent legal workflows.** You'll orchestrate specialized agents (intake, research, drafting, filing, follow\-up) that collaborate on a single matter, such as a consumer complaint moving from facts to legal notice to e\-Daakhil filing to hearing reminders.
* **Tool\-using agents.** You'll give agents secure access to tools and APIs via function calling and MCP, including legal databases, eCourts, consumer forums, DigiLocker, payments, e\-sign, WhatsApp, and email.
* **Browser and computer\-use agents.** You'll automate interactions with government and court portals that lack APIs, with robust handling of CAPTCHAs (via human handoff), timeouts, and UI changes.
* **Long\-running, stateful agents.** You'll use durable execution (Temporal, LangGraph, or similar) for matters that span weeks, with checkpointing, retries, and resumability.
* **Agent memory.** You'll design short\-term, episodic, and case\-level memory so agents retain facts, documents, and history across sessions without leaking context between users.
* **Planning and self\-correction.** You'll implement task decomposition, reflection loops, and verifier agents that check citations, facts, and document validity before anything reaches a user.
* **Human\-in\-the\-loop controls.** You'll build approval gates for high\-stakes actions (filing, sending notices, payments), plus confidence\-based escalation to in\-house lawyers and seamless lawyer takeover.
* **Grounded legal reasoning.** You'll build agentic RAG over statutes, case law, and regulations, where agents decide what to retrieve, iterate on queries, and cite every claim.

**What You'll Own**

* **Agent evals.** This covers trajectory\-level evaluation (did the agent take the right steps, not just produce the right answer), task success rates, tool\-call accuracy, and regression suites built with lawyers.
* **Observability.** You'll trace every agent decision, tool call, and handoff, keeping full audit trails suitable for legal accountability.
* **Safety and permissions.** You'll scope tool access tightly, sandbox execution, defend against prompt injection from user uploads and web content, and enforce action\-level authorization.
* **Cost and latency.** You'll handle model routing across frontier and open\-source models, caching, and token budgets per matter.
* **Compliance.** You'll ensure DPDP Act–compliant data handling, including consent, PII redaction, and retention policies across agent memory.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**What We're Looking For**

**Must\-have**

* 3\+ years in software/ML engineering, with 1\+ year building LLM agents in production (not just prototypes)
* Deep experience with tool use and function calling; working knowledge of MCP
* Hands\-on with agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK), and a clear sense of when *not* to use them
* Experience building evals for multi\-step agent behavior and debugging agent failures systematically
* Strong Python, backend fundamentals (APIs, Postgres, queues, async), and cloud deployment (AWS/GCP)
* Solid RAG foundations: embeddings, vector DBs (pgvector, Qdrant), hybrid search, reranking

**Good to have**

* Browser automation (Playwright) or computer\-use agents
* Durable workflow engines (Temporal, Inngest)
* Legal\-tech, fintech, or other regulated\-domain experience
* Indic language or voice agents (ASR/TTS, WhatsApp\-native flows)
* Familiarity with India's DPI stack (DigiLocker, Aadhaar eKYC, eCourts)

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**Why Join**

* Build agents that do real work and deliver real outcomes for real people, expanding access to justice across India
* Greenfield agent architecture with high ownership from day one
* Access to the India Accelerator ecosystem of ventures, founders, and tech leadership
* Competitive compensation plus ESOPs

jobs.description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.


At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision\-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

We’re seeking a passionate and experienced Senior Python \& Machine Learning Engineer to join our Data domain team. * Databricks, Delta Lake, MLflow

SQL, NoSQL

**What's In It For You**
========================

At FactSet, our people are our greatest asset, and our culture is our biggest competitive advantage. Being a FactSetter means:


* The opportunity to join an S\&P 500 company with over 45 years of sustainable growth powered by the entrepreneurial spirit of a start\-up.
* Support for your total well\-being. This includes health, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement savings plans and a discounted employee stock purchase program, plus paid time off for holidays, family leave, and company\-wide wellness days.
* Flexible work accommodations. We value work/life harmony and offer our employees a range of accommodations to help them achieve success both at work and in their personal lives.

* Career progression planning with dedicated time each month for learning and development.

Business Resource Groups open to all employees that serve as a catalyst for connection, growth, and belonging.

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS \| NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy\-side and sell\-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next\-generation workflow solutions, and client\-centric specialized support. As a member of the S\&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .


At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

jobs.description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-251195 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 22, 2026 CATEGORY: Engineering
**Software Engineer, Full Stack — Decision Intelligence**

**ABOUT AMGEN**


Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today.

 **The opportunity**


Amgen’s AI \& Data Science team is building decision\-intelligence products that help teams make faster, more defensible decisions under uncertainty. We are seeking a **Software Engineer, Decision Intelligence** to join the Forecasting \& Decision Intelligence team within the AI \& Data organization. This role will help develop scenario\-planning capabilities—including visualization, capacity, and AI\-assisted decision workflows—while contributing to reusable foundations for forecasting, simulation, optimization, and decision products across the enterprise.


We are seeking a Full\-Stack Engineer who can build high\-quality product experiences across the frontend and backend. You will develop the interfaces people use to configure, launch, monitor, compare, and understand complex scenarios, as well as the APIs, data integrations, and execution services that make those experiences trustworthy.

 **What you will do**

* Develop intuitive planner experiences for configuring scenarios, managing assumptions, monitoring runs, comparing outcomes, and understanding uncertainty and trade\-offs.
* Build responsive, accessible React/TypeScript user interfaces and reusable frontend components for scenario setup, results visualization, and decision workflows.
* Develop APIs, backend services, data integrations, and execution workflows for forecasting, simulation, optimization, and AI\-assisted decision products.
* Work closely with product managers, planners, data scientists, and adjacent engineering teams to translate business needs into clear, valuable product increments.
* Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

 **Basic qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5\+ years of professional software\-engineering experience building and supporting production applications.
* Full\-stack engineering experience, including modern frontend development with React and TypeScript and backend API development with Python or another modern server\-side language.
* Experience building usable, data\-rich web applications in partnership with product, design, and business stakeholders.
* Experience with relational SQL and data\-intensive applications, including integration with warehouse, lakehouse, or operational data systems.
* Familiarity with asynchronous processing, queues, workflow engines, or similar patterns for long\-running workloads.
* Experience with cloud deployment, containers, CI/CD, automated testing, and production troubleshooting.
* Commitment to code quality, accessibility, documentation, observability, and operational ownership.

 **Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with FastAPI, Databricks, Spark, Kubernetes, modular frontend architectures, or comparable technologies.
* Experience building interactive visualizations and comparison workflows for analytical, operational, financial, or planning users.
* Experience embedding statistical models, optimization engines, simulation, or machine\-learning capabilities into production applications.
* Experience with API and data\-contract versioning, enterprise identity and access management, and secure integrations.
* Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, healthcare, finance, or another complex operational domain.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted product experiences and appropriate grounding, evaluation, and human\-review controls.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Full Stack Engineer to join our engineering team. This role is critical to designing, developing, and delivering scalable, high\-quality software solutions that power our products. You will work at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution — collaborating with Product Owners, Product Managers, and Architects to translate business needs into optimal technical solutions, while championing engineering excellence, Agile best practices, and the adoption of agentic AI tools across the software development lifecycle (SDLC).


This role is ideal for an engineer who is not only technically strong in full stack and microservices development, but also curious and proactive about integrating agentic AI development practices — such as AI coding agents, autonomous/semi\-autonomous workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers — into everyday engineering work to improve speed, quality, and consistency.


* Solution Design \& Development: Work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, and Architects to design and develop optimal, scalable technical solutions that meet both business and user needs.
* Backlog \& Risk Management: Understand business priorities, user needs, and technical feasibility to help prioritize the product backlog, and proactively manage risks and dependencies across features and teams.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross\-functional teams (QA, DevOps, UX, Product) to deliver timely, high\-quality, and well\-tested code that meets defined acceptance criteria and quality standards.
* Microservices Development: Design and develop microservices architecture, building loosely coupled services that decompose larger applications into smaller, well\-defined, independently deployable components.
* API Development: Design, build, and maintain APIs that enable seamless communication and integration between individual microservices and external systems.
* Code Quality \& Automation: Enforce best practices in refactoring, continuous integration, and automation to ensure code is clean, maintainable, and scalable over time.
* Agile \& DevOps Practices: Actively participate in Daily Stand\-ups and other Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, backlog grooming). Champion the adoption of Agile, DevOps, and software craftsmanship practices, including CI/CD, Test\-Driven Development (TDD), and Pair Programming.
* ### **Agentic AI in the Development Lifecycle**
* Integrate agentic AI tools and coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar AI agents) into day\-to\-day development workflows to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and code review.
* Design and implement agentic development workflows where AI agents autonomously or semi\-autonomously handle well\-defined engineering tasks (e.g., scaffolding services, generating unit tests, refactoring code, resolving bugs) under human oversight.
* Configure, integrate, and work with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to connect AI agents with internal tools, APIs, codebases, and data sources in a secure and governed manner.
* Evaluate and apply prompt engineering and context management best practices to maximize the effectiveness, reliability, and safety of AI\-assisted development outputs.
* Establish guardrails, validation steps, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints to ensure AI\-generated code meets quality, security, and compliance standards before merging.
* Continuously experiment with and evaluate emerging agentic AI tools, frameworks, and patterns (e.g., multi\-agent orchestration, autonomous coding agents, AI\-driven CI/CD pipelines), and share learnings and recommendations with the broader engineering team.
* Partner with architects and platform teams to define standards and best practices for responsible, secure, and scalable use of agentic AI across the SDLC.
* Technical Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and mid\-level engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, engineering excellence, and effective AI\-augmented development.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay current with emerging technologies, tools, and industry trends — especially in agentic AI and AI\-assisted software engineering — and proactively recommend improvements to team processes, architecture, and tooling.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience, with demonstrated full stack expertise (front\-end and back\-end).
* Strong experience designing and building microservices architectures.
* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python).
* Experience with front\-end frameworks (e.g., React, Angular) and back\-end frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, Node.js).
* Solid understanding of RESTful API design and development; experience with API gateways and service\-to\-service communication.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling
* Practical, hands\-on experience using agentic AI coding tools and assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) as part of the daily development workflow.
* Working knowledge of agentic development processes — understanding how AI agents plan, reason, and execute multi\-step engineering tasks with appropriate human oversight.
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and how they are used to connect AI agents/LLMs with internal tools, data sources, and codebases.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience actively participating in Agile ceremonies.
* Practical experience with Test\-Driven Development (TDD), unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing frameworks.
* Experience working with GCP cloud platforms
* Excellent problem\-solving ski

**Role Purpose**


The AI Engineer will help manage the organization's AI technology estate end\-to\-end — from platform administration and licensing through to usage monitoring, cost control, and governance. This is a highly technical, operationally\-focused role suited to someone who enjoys managing infrastructure and data\-driven reporting, ensuring the business gets maximum value and control from its AI tools while keeping usage secure, compliant, and cost\-effective.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer the organization's AI platforms and tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, or equivalent), including user provisioning, seat/license management, and access controls.
* Manage the full lifecycle of AI licensing: seat allocation across teams, and right\-sizing licenses (e.g., Standard vs. Premium seats) based on actual usage patterns.
* Monitor and report on AI usage and spend across the organization, building dashboards and regular reports for leadership on adoption, cost, ROI, and utilization trends.
* Set and manage spend limits, usage policies, and cost controls at the organizational and user level to prevent budget overruns.
* Configure and maintain integrations, connectors, and admin settings (SSO, SCIM, audit logs, data retention policies) across AI platforms.
* Act as the internal point of contact for AI platform troubleshooting, access issues, and vendor support escalations.
* Maintain an accurate inventory (the "AI estate") of all AI tools, licenses, connectors, and integrations in use across the business, including shadow IT discovery where relevant.
* Evaluate new AI tools, features, and licensing models as they become available, and make recommendations on adoption or consolidation.
* Ensure AI tool usage aligns with the organization's security, data governance, and compliance requirements.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 3\+ years of experience in IT administration, systems/platform management, or a similar technical operations role.
* Hands\-on experience managing SaaS platform administration (user provisioning, licensing, SSO/SCIM configuration) — experience with AI platforms (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI/ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, etc.) strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience building usage/cost reports and dashboards (Excel, Power BI, or similar).
* Familiarity with API\-based usage billing models and cost management practices.
* Understanding of enterprise IT governance concepts: SSO, audit logs, data retention, access controls.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical usage data into business\-relevant insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with vendor account management/support teams for renewals, escalations, and contract queries.
* A proactive, detail\-oriented approach to license optimization and cost control.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

* Prior experience specifically administering an enterprise AI platform (e.g., Claude for Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, OpenAI Enterprise).
